title: In the S584 Check, replace `gofmt -l ./engine` with `gofmt -l .` (the AGENTS.md form); the implementer should run `gofmt -l .` and expect no output

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The spec-check reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in spec check of S584, project ork, item S584:

In the S584 Check, replace `gofmt -l ./engine` with `gofmt -l .` (the AGENTS.md form); the implementer should run `gofmt -l .` and expect no output

Evidence: /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork/engine does not exist (`ls` exits 2); the package is internal/engine, so `gofmt -l ./engine` errors instead of printing nothing
